---
applyTo: "**/products/*.html"
---

- Theory-coverage data (scale/chord/interval names, symbols, interval tokens,
  Roman numerals, function tags, circle-of-fifths/circle-of-thirds content) stays
  in **English in every locale**. This is deliberate, consistent notation is part
  of the product, not an oversight to "fix" during translation.
- Only headings (`h2`/`h3`/`h4`), intro paragraphs, and `<th>` header labels get
  translated on these pages. Table body data and tag lists do not.
- Brand and technical tokens (Siri, Shortcuts, Spotlight, Dynamic Island, Live
  Activity, Notification Center, BPM, Hz, kHz, FM, LFO, MIDI) stay as-is in every
  locale — don't translate or localize them.
